# Saltmarsh Bakehouse

> Saltmarsh Bakehouse is an invented neighbourhood bakery in Tidewater Bay, NSW. It bakes long-ferment sourdough, seeded rye and Saturday cinnamon scrolls, and supplies bread to local cafes.

## Pages

- [Home](https://saltmarsh.example/): what the bakehouse makes, when it's open and how to call

## What we do

- Daily sourdough loaves
- Wholesale bread for cafes
- Saturday cinnamon scrolls
